Hope, Resilience and Friendship
A very warm welcome from our Headteacher
At Meridian Angel Primary, we pride ourselves on being an inclusive and welcoming Church of England School. We serve a diverse community and provide a safe and exciting learning environment in which ambitious, but realistic, expectations and high-quality teaching ensure that each and every child achieves their very best. Our school's values of Hope, Friendship and Resilience are at the heart of our ethos, curriculum and collective worship. We are committed to ensuring that children grow up in God's love to be happy, well-rounded young people ready for the challenges of our rapidly-changing world. We cannot do that without the input and support of Parents, Carers, families and the wider community, which is why we place great value on our home-school and other partnerships. Mr Lawrence Desouza Headteacher
The LDBS Academies Trust
LAT was created in 2012 with five schools spread across the London Borough of Haringey. Our mission is to establish, maintain, carry on, manage and develop Church of England Schools across the Diocese of London. Our aim is that every child should have the opportunity to flourish and develop into a rounded adult who can live life to the full.

Religious Education and Collective worship
As part of a Church of England Trust school, we provide religious education and daily collective worship for all pupils and promote their spiritual, moral, and cultural development in accordance with the Law. Our pupils show a strong sense of respect for others’ values and faiths as demonstrated in collective worship, lesson observations and work. In this school Christianity forms the core of what we uphold and teach and believe it to be evident in the ethos of the school. At the same time, however, we acknowledge and value the multi-faith nature of our community and society. The school maintains close links with the parish church of Saint Peter’s https://www.achurchnearyou.com/church/15616/ . As a school we believe worship to be an act of adoration or reverence offered to God for his activities in the world which forms an integral part of our identity and the education provided by this school. Reverend Tina leads our collective worship once a week and leads on services for some of the major Christian festivals, or on special occasions throughout the year. Headteacher's Welcome
At Meridian Angel Primary School, we pride ourselves on being an inclusive and welcoming Church of England School. We serve a diverse community and provide a safe and exciting learning environment in which ambitious, but realistic, expectations and high-quality teaching ensure that each and every child achieves their very best.
Our school’s values of Friendship, Resilience and Hope are at the heart of our ethos, curriculum and collective worship. We are committed to ensuring that children grow up in God’s love to be happy, well-rounded young people ready for the challenges of our rapidly-changing world. We cannot do that without the input and support of Parents, Carers, families and the wider community, which is why we place great value on our home-school and other partnerships.
As part of the London Diocesan Board for Schools (LDBS) Academies Trust, we share best practice with a number of London schools within the Trust. To find out more, please go to https://www.ldbsact.org/
All are welcome at our wonderful school. We look forward to meeting you!

Vision & Values
Welcome to Meridian Angel Primary School. We are a safe and inclusive community deeply rooted in God's love and grounded in his teachings that all life is to be nurtured and cherished.
As members of a calm and stable learning environment, everyone will experience equal opportunities for growth and exploration and the gift of supportive, caring FRIENDSHIPS within which the seeds of RESILIENCE are planted and watered. Our HOPE is that all can blossom and flourish continuing to grow into the people they have been created to be.
Ephesians 3: 14-17 For this reason I bow my knees before the Father, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name. I pray that, according to the riches of his glory, he may grant that you may be strengthened in your inner being with power through his Spirit, and that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, as you are being rooted and grounded in love.

pageCache.text:
Headteacher's Welcome
At Meridian Angel Primary School, we pride ourselves on being an inclusive and welcoming Church of England School. We serve a diverse community and provide a safe and exciting learning environment in which ambitious, but realistic, expectations and high-quality teaching ensure that each and every child achieves their very best.
Our school’s values of Friendship, Resilience and Hope are at the heart of our ethos, curriculum and collective worship. We are committed to ensuring that children grow up in God’s love to be happy, well-rounded young people ready for the challenges of our rapidly-changing world. We cannot do that without the input and support of Parents, Carers, families and the wider community, which is why we place great value on our home-school and other partnerships.
As part of the London Diocesan Board for Schools (LDBS) Academies Trust, we share best practice with a number of London schools within the Trust. To find out more, please go to https://www.ldbsact.org/
All are welcome at our wonderful school. We look forward to meeting you!
The LDBS Academies Trust
LAT was created in 2012 with five schools spread across the London Borough of Haringey. Our mission is to establish, maintain, carry on, manage and develop Church of England Schools across the Diocese of London. Our aim is that every child should have the opportunity to flourish and develop into a rounded adult who can live life to the full.

pageCache.pageTitle: Meridian Angel Primary School - SMSC (Social, Moral, Spiritual, Cultural)
pageCache.text:
SMSC (Social, Moral, Spiritual, Cultural)
SMSC is at the heart of all learning. We plan opportunities to explore the strands of SMSC though our learning time and collective worship. Stimulas is drawn from our creative curriculum, recent events (school or in the media) and for our values both as an LDBS school and uniquely to Meridian Angel Primary School.
Social
Participating, co-operating and resolving conflicts.
Understanding how communities and societies function.
Moral
Developing and expressing personal views or values.
Investigating moral values and ethical issues.
Recognising right and wrong and applying it.
Understanding the Consequences of actions.
Spiritual
Developing personal values and beliefs.
Experiencing fascination, awe and wonder
Exploring the values and beliefs of others.
Understanding human emotions.
Using imagination and creativity in learning
